description: Campus-recruiting job screening workflow — read job listing screenshots, reverse-look-up the full JD, rate fit against the candidate's own profile and hard filters, then output a fixed four-section report with referral codes attached per job. Triggers on job listing screenshots, "这个岗位投不投", "帮我看看这个岗", "还有哪些值得投".
